limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Behavior before the first synchronous reset is unspecified and is not constrained by the testbench.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation: synchronous reset sets a three-bit saturating counter to zero; shift_ena stays asserted for four intervals and remains low after the count reaches four. No subsequent RTL edits.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent remaining-cycle oracle checks pre-edge and post-edge outputs, reset restarts at every countdown boundary, held reset, idle stability, and a reset pulse without a positive clock edge. No subsequent testbench edits.
interface_cycle_semantics: Original TopModule ports preserved; active-high synchronous reset; no extra latency or ports.
static_review: Single sequential driver, nonblocking assignments, explicitly sized three-bit counter arithmetic, no wraparound after completion.
